findings.evidence: template/scripts/platform_doctor.py:55-57 reads only the physical line beginning with ci_runner_labels:, while template/.copier-answers.yml.jinja:2 serializes answers using to_nice_yaml. A valid value such as 'self-hosted, linux, production-network, dedicated-platform-validation, company-build-runner' can serialize across two lines. Reproducing with PyYAML's default serializer wraps after 'dedicated-platform-validation,', leaving 'company-build-runner' on the continuation line. The doctor reads the truncated value ending in a comma and reports an empty entry, although the YAML value and rendered runner list are valid. Parse the complete YAML scalar rather than extracting its first line.
findings.summary: The doctor truncates valid multiline YAML label answers, causing correctly rendered self-hosted projects to fail CI.
